title: D-CALM: A Dynamic Clustering-based Active Learning Approach for Mitigating Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing label and error distributions for underrepresented groups (e.g., Persons of Color) in a fine-grained hatespeech dataset across different active learning sampling methods.
Analyzing label and error distributions for hatespeech targeting religious groups (e.g., Jews, Muslims) during active learning iterations.
Analyzing label and error distributions for hatespeech targeting women to evaluate representation in active learning sampling.
Measuring the label distribution and error rates for hatespeech targeting disabled individuals to assess model equity during active learning.
Evaluating label and error distributions for hatespeech targeting LGBT+ individuals across different active learning baselines.
Analyzing the selection frequency and error rates for hatespeech targeting migrants during active learning iterations.
